Specialty and decorative

Decorative and specialty paint finishes in Sydney

Some walls deserve more than a single flat colour. Decorative finishes add texture, sheen and character, from soft mineral limewash to metallic shimmer and raw concrete looks, all applied by hand to suit the room.

Sydney Paintmasters is the decorating side of a painting business. We create feature walls and specialty finishes that lift a space, then back them with the same careful preparation and tidy work you would expect on a full repaint.

This page is the home for our decorative work. For hand trowelled lime plaster in particular, we have a dedicated venetian plaster service as well.

In focus

Limewash painting

Limewash is one of the most popular decorative finishes we are asked for, and for good reason. It is a mineral paint that soaks into the surface rather than sitting on top, giving a soft, matt, slightly cloudy look with real depth. As the light changes through the day, the wall changes with it.

It suits heritage homes and modern interiors alike, and works on interior feature walls as well as selected exterior surfaces such as render and brick. Because it is breathable, it is a natural fit for older Sydney homes where trapped moisture can be a problem.

We prepare the surface properly, apply limewash in the traditional way and seal it where the location needs added durability, so you get the look without the flaking that comes from a rushed job.

props.label: Decorative finishes questions
props.html:
Good to know

Decorative finishes questions

What decorative finishes do you offer?

We create limewash, metallic and pearl finishes, faux concrete and microcement looks, textured finishes and feature wall colour work. For hand trowelled lime plaster, we also offer a dedicated venetian plaster service.

What is limewash and where can it be used?

Limewash is a breathable mineral paint that soaks into the surface for a soft, matt, cloudy look with depth. It suits interior feature walls and selected exteriors such as render and brick, and is a natural fit for older Sydney homes.

Do you do venetian plaster as well?

Yes. Venetian plaster is a hand trowelled lime finish and we have a dedicated venetian plaster page with the full detail. Decorative finishes covers our wider range of limewash, metallic, concrete look and textured finishes.

Can decorative finishes be used in bathrooms or outdoors?

Some can, when they are chosen and sealed correctly. Limewash suits selected exteriors, and certain finishes can be sealed for wet areas. We match the finish to the location and prepare and protect it accordingly.

Will you provide samples before we commit?

Yes. We prepare sample boards in your colours and sheens so you can see the finish on your wall and in your light before we begin. Nothing is committed until you are happy.

How durable are decorative finishes?

With proper preparation and the right sealing, decorative finishes hold up well. Durability depends on the finish and where it is used, so we advise on care and seal the surface where the room needs extra protection.
